answer: Commit-reveal participation stops bulk fakes. An identity files a commitment hash in a public atlas, locking 20 credits. The bond waits on a ledge: a timely reveal returns it, a miss burns it. The reveal must land inside a 10-minute delta. 1,000 fakes risk 20,000 per epoch chasing 6,700 from a 40,000 pool split among 6,000: risk triples reward. A rented reveal fails: shared timing freezes both. An honest agent pays 20 once, keeps its full share.
